name: Cuscuta: A Prayer for Endless Winter
source:
As you stroll through the Orator's library, you drag your fingers across the spines of various tomes, sampling all the different textures with your fingertips. You come to the end of the great bookshelf and, as you turn your head to find more stimulation for your wandering hands, one particular book catches your eye. "A Record of Lesbianism in the Kingdom of Hortus". 

A record of two deceptive women spending a long winter together in a small cabin told via intimate interviews after the fact. An examination of what it means to be seen and to allow yourself to be seen.

[Edited from [url=https://tabbiedearest.itch.io/cuscuta]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当你漫步在演说家图书馆时，你可以将手指拖过各种书籍的书脊，用指尖采样所有不同的纹理。你来到大书架的尽头，当你转过头去寻找更多刺激你游移的双手时，一本特别的书引起了你的注意。《霍图斯王国女同性恋记录》。

事后通过亲密采访讲述了两个欺骗性的女人在一个小木屋里一起度过漫长冬天的记录。审视被人看见以及让自己被人看见意味着什么。

[编辑自[url=https://tabbiedearest.itch.io/cuscuta]itch.io[/url]]
